text: ὁ Πάνδα καὶ ὁ Διναύσαρος φοβοῦνται καὶ φεύγουσιν εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
positioning: Panda runs toward the agora entrance with a frightened expression
Dinosaur follows close behind, also looking scared
Ophis watches them from behind with his head raised curiously
The bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit lies abandoned on the ground
